title: Nellie Narwhal and the Northern Lights | Colour Adventure for Kids

music.emotional_arrangement: glass harp and soft strings for dusk; low cello and distant frame drum as fog gathers; celesta and warm humming at each colour clue; full but gentle aurora chorus for the reunion

voices.delivery: melodic colour-and-kindness story-song with acted character phrases; no flat narration

continuity.nellie: one periwinkle-blue young narwhal with warm ivory belly, short pearly spiral tusk, deep teal eyes and a small magenta star-freckle cluster beside the left eye
continuity.kiko: one small silver-white harp seal pup with charcoal crescent spots, teal eyes and a rounded charcoal nose
continuity.mara_mother_seal: one larger silver harp seal with the same crescent markings and warm brown eyes
continuity.oona: one tiny orange Arctic char with a blue dorsal fin who stays near Nellie's right flipper
continuity.geography: a low safe starting floe at frame-left, three traceable under-ice colour chambers, an open calm swimming lane and the family floe at frame-right
continuity.safety_rule: Kiko waits on stable ice until the calm open-water lane is visible, then swims beside Nellie; no cracking ice, storms, predators or peril imagery.

scenes.action: At Arctic dusk Nellie and Oona notice Kiko waiting on the low left floe while his mother calls from the distant right family floe through gentle mist.
lyrics: Evening hums beneath the Arctic ice.
Kiko waits across the silver water.
Nellie sings, we'll find your way.
scenes.hero: Kiko and mother separated by one calm misty lane

scenes.action: Nellie maps a safe route under the ice: green arch, blue bubble chamber and violet crystal window, all visible in one connected cross-section.
lyrics: Three soft colours mark the journey.
Green, then blue, then violet light.
Follow slowly; keep them near.
scenes.hero: three colour chambers in exact order

scenes.action: Nellie swims beneath a translucent green aurora arch and sends one gentle bubble signal up to Kiko's floe.
lyrics: Green light curls beneath the floe.
Nellie follows every emerald ribbon.
One round bubble says, I'm here.
scenes.hero: green reflection and one bubble signal

scenes.action: In the blue chamber Oona circles one bioluminescent blue jelly while Nellie keeps the clear open lane in sight.
lyrics: Blue light glows through quiet water.
Oona circles one soft lantern.
The open lane stays clear.
scenes.hero: one blue jelly and visible clear lane

scenes.action: A violet ice window reflects the final colour; Nellie aligns her tusk with the safe gap without touching the ice.
lyrics: Violet shimmers through the window.
Nellie's pearl tusk points beside it.
Three bright clues now make one path.
scenes.hero: violet window beside a visible water gap

scenes.action: Mist briefly dims the surface, so Kiko rests safely while Nellie and Oona pause beneath the ice and repeat the colours together.
lyrics: Soft mist hides the faraway floe.
Kiko rests; brave can be quiet.
Green, blue, violet—we remember.
scenes.hero: safe pause and remembered colour sequence

scenes.action: The three reflected colours join into a continuous route across the calm lane; mother becomes clearly visible on the family floe.
lyrics: Green meets blue; violet follows.
Colour ribbons cross the calm lane.
Mother waits where warm lights meet.

scenes.action: Kiko enters the calm water and swims beside Nellie while Oona leads; they follow the exact green-blue-violet route to the right floe.
lyrics: Kiko splashes into gentle water.
Side by side, they swim together.
Green, blue, violet guide them home.

scenes.action: Kiko reunites nose-to-nose with his mother on the family floe as Nellie and Oona surface beneath a full green-blue-violet aurora.
lyrics: Nose meets nose beneath the stars.
Northern colours sing above them.
Kind lights guide us home together.
scenes.hero: one warm family reunion and full-colour aurora

quality_requirements: Nellie, Kiko, Mara, Oona, both floes and all three colour chambers retain exact identity and geography.
Green, blue and violet appear and are sung in the same order; no unrelated colour becomes a route clue.
Kiko remains safely on stable ice until scene 8 and swims beside Nellie only in the established calm lane.
Ice remains intact; no cracking, breaking, predator, storm, drowning or frightening rescue imagery.
One colour clue is the visual hero per clue scene; ambient sea life remains restrained.
Real water, bubble, fin, jelly, mist, ice-hum and aurora effects replace spoken imitation words.
The reunion and full three-colour aurora appear only in scene 9.
All shared gates in premium-musical-video-set-2026-08-31.json pass before release.
